title: Assessment of Students under Police Investigation for Suicide Risk
what_it_is: Assessment of Students under Police Investigation for Suicide Risk

sections.label: School counsellors suicide risk training
sections.summary: All school counsellors are trained to carry out suicide risk assessments.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: Currently, all our school counsellors are trained to carry out suicide risk assessments.

sections.label: Police investigations and student well-being
sections.summary: Schools check students' well-being when Police require assistance, assessing suicide risk only for those showing serious distress or known mental health concerns.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: Currently, when the Police go to a school to require a student's assistance in investigations, the school leaders or staff will first check on the physical and emotional well-being of the student.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: We do not conduct a suicide risk assessment for every case as such screening may add distress or confusion to some students, especially for those who have not even contemplated suicide.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: Instead, our approach is to conduct suicide risk assessments for students who show signs of serious emotional distress or who have mental health concerns that are known to the school.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: Subsequent developments that occur after the assessment can also alter the risk profile of the student.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: It is, therefore, more important to ensure that there is consistent monitoring and support to ensure the safety and well-being of the child throughout and following the period of Police investigation.

sections.label: MOE review of Police procedures
sections.summary: MOE participates in the review of Police procedures for juvenile offenders and is open to school counsellors as appropriate adults.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: MOE is already participating in the review of Police procedures involving juvenile offenders.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: Depending on the recommendations of the review, MOE is open to the possibility of school counsellors as "appropriate adults" to be present with the students.
